tieAudit.interpretation: Tie-rule sensitivity on already observed outcomes, not a predictive significance test.

diagnostics.interpretation: Each simulation repeats each entire scan; seven new test families are Bonferroni-adjusted. Historical exploratory diagnostics, not proof of fairness.

negativeControls.interpretation: Finite simulation of this fixed search under fair draws; not proof that an observed historical winner is genuine.

detectionPower.assumption: Hypothetical IID exponential tilt of fair hit counts; mean-only test, not all practical gates.

commonPatterns.interpretation: Pattern classes contain many combinations; individual combinations remain equiprobable under fairness.
